subject: Re: Renewal proposal — Hosted API annual commit restructure & tiered burst
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>
To: Claire Huang <claire@animata.ai>, procure@animata.ai
Cc: Luke Ramos <luke@animata.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal proposal — Hosted API annual commit restructure & tiered burst

Hi Claire / team,

As we approach your March 1 renewal, I wanted to put a proposal on the table that matches the growth you're seeing in production and keeps unit costs predictable. Summary:

- Current: $10k/mo hosted commit (baseline), standard rate limits (60 rps per key).
- Proposed: move to $18k/mo annual committed plan (12-month term), with a +2x burst pool and adjusted rate tiers: 60 rps -> 120 rps baseline per API key, with optional pre-paid burst credits for sustained spikes.

Why we think this helps Animata:
- Reduces per-token marginal cost by ~22% at your 3M token/mo run rate.
- Gives you predictable capacity during model rollouts and marketing spikes.
- We can configure a canary route that stays on your existing profile for 72 hours, with automatic fallback rules if latency/SLA thresholds are hit.

What I need from you to move forward:
1) Confirmation that a 12-month annual commit is acceptable (I can prepare an addendum).
2) Expected peak rps and number of concurrent users during your largest campaign in the next quarter (Luke/ops can share).
3) Any procurement PO timing or specific legal redlines we should anticipate.

I've attached a draft addendum that shows the new pricing and rate-tier breakdown plus the proposed SLA tweak for burst behavior. Link to HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/HS-2026-789

Attachments: redwood_commit_addendum_v3.pdf, redwood_sla_amendment.pdf

If you prefer, we can hop on a 30-min call this week to walk the numbers.

Thanks —
Nikhil
Nikhil Sharma
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
nikhil@redwood.com

1) Can you confirm the exact per-token pricing at the $18k/mo commit (both generation and embedding)? We need line-item pricing for our PO.
2) How does the burst credit consumption work: is it consumed immediately at the higher rate, or averaged over a window? We run periodic bursts that last 10–30 minutes.
3) Any flexibility on start date? Our fiscal year alignment would prefer a March 15 start if there's no technical blocker.

Also copying procurement so they can flag any contract/PO cadence.

Best,

Claire — thanks for the quick reply. Short answers up front: per-token numbers and burst mechanics below, but I'm looping in Monica (Customer Success) to validate the technical side and Laura (Sales Lead) on the commercial timing / discount.

Per-token pricing at $18k/mo (annual commit):
- Generation: $0.0009 / token
- Embeddings: $0.00025 / embedding unit
- Pre-paid burst credits: $0.45 / 1000 tokens (applied when you exceed baseline rps for sustained windows)

Burst credit mechanics:
- Short spikes (<=2 minutes): served from a transient burst pool (no immediate charge if under free buffer).
- Sustained spikes (>2 minutes): we start consuming pre-paid burst credits; credits are deducted in 1-minute windows based on consumed tokens.

Start date: We can set effective date to March 15; SLA and billing will align to that date.

Monica / Laura — can you validate the suggested rps tiers and whether a 2-week trial of an increased burst pool is feasible for Animata? Also flag any ops-side constraints.

Thanks,
Nikhil

[Attachment: redwood_commit_addendum_v3.pdf]

Subject: Re: Renewal proposal — Hosted API annual commit restructure & tiered burst

Hi all — I reviewed Animata's reported traffic patterns and tried two conservative configurations in our staging region. Notes: 

- Baseline per-key rps of 120 is fine for standard gen requests if average request length < 800 tokens. Latency remains within current p50/p90 SLOs when continuous batching is enabled.
- For 10–30 minute marketing spikes, KV cache hits fall to ~40% which increases effective cost ~12% above baseline; pre-paid burst credits will cover the difference.
- Suggested config: baseline commit 18k/mo, burst pool = 750k tokens/month pre-paid, with auto-triggered 30-min trial window upon go-live so Animata can validate production behavior.

Attachments: load-profile.csv (sample traffic histogram), redwood_sla_amendment.pdf (edited with trial clause).

Operational asks for Animata: please confirm the largest expected concurrent new sessions in a 5-minute window and whether you can route a traffic mirror to our staging endpoint for the 2-week trial.

I'll coordinate with infra to reserve the burst pool starting on March 15 (if we get PO).

Cheers,
Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.com

Hi Claire — following on the technical validation, here's the commercial summary we're ready to commit to: 

- 12-month annual commit: $18,000 / month billed monthly in arrears, effective March 15, 2026.
- Included: 1 baseline API key configured to 120 rps, 750k tokens/month pre-paid burst credits.
- Additional tokens billed per usage: generation $0.0009 / token; embeddings $0.00025 / unit; overage bursts billed against pre-paid credits at $0.45 / 1k tokens thereafter.
- One-time loyalty discount applied: 10% on the first 3 months (applies to the committed monthly invoice).
- 2-week production trial of increased burst pool with traffic mirror; metrics reviewed at day 7 and day 14.

I've attached the SOW addendum and a DocuSign link to sign the amendment. Please route PO to procure@animata.ai and reply-all with the expected PO date so we can reserve capacity.
